patch.summary:
Choose ActiveCampaign only if your buying job matches “Email marketing automation ESP with multi-step journeys; CRM pipelines strongest on Plus+;” rather than InboxAlly's shape. Choose InboxAlly only if your buying job matches “Email deliverability and reputation repair via seed engagement and inbox placement tooling” rather than ActiveCampaign's shape. Workflow advantage: ActiveCampaign leans marketing-automation, lead-nurturing; InboxAlly leans small-business-campaigns, ecommerce-email. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: ActiveCampaign is Email marketing automation ESP with multi-step journeys; CRM pipelines strongest on Plus+; contact-based pricing.; InboxAlly is Email deliverability and reputation repair via seed engagement and inbox placement tooling..
- Company-size focus: ActiveCampaign (micro, small-business, mid-market) vs InboxAlly (small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: ActiveCampaign-leaning marketing-automation, lead-nurturing, newsletters vs InboxAlly-leaning small-business-campaigns, ecommerce-email.
- Researched limits: ActiveCampaign — Confirm live ActiveCampaign checkout; packaging can change.; InboxAlly — Not a campaign platform — complements an ESP.

Limitations — ActiveCampaign: Confirm live ActiveCampaign checkout; packaging can change.; InboxAlly: Not a campaign platform — complements an ESP; Pricing scales steeply with sender profiles and seed volume.
